content.short: Covenant is a liquid credit market on Monad that turns on-chain assets into leverage and yield.
content.description: Covenant turns any on-chain asset into fully backed leverage on one side and yield on the other, acting as a liquid credit layer on Monad. Each market lists its base asset alongside the leverage token and yield token minted against it, and positions stay liquid rather than locked for a fixed term. Deposits into the yield side fund the leverage side, and both are tradeable while open.
content.meta: A Monad credit market where positions stay liquid instead of locking for a fixed term.
